# Day Break Electric

> > Full-service electrical contractor in Tucson, Arizona providing residential, commercial, LED, and maintenance services with licensed technicians.

Day Break Electric is a local electrical contracting company serving Southern Arizona with expertise in both residential and commercial electrical work. The company is licensed (ROC Numbers 088680 and 088685) and offers free estimates, maintenance contracts, and specialized LED installation services.
